results_section.claim: 3. Expert-only prompts (S2, S3) yield higher medians for lenient accuracy (around 65-70%) compared to context-augmented ones (S4, S5; around 55-60%).
results_section.explanation: Execution stage: The directional claim (S2,S3 > S4,S5 for lenient accuracy) is correct, but the specific ranges are inaccurate. S3 at 59.61% is NOT 'around 65-70%' — it is actually ~60%, nearly identical to S4 (58.67%). The claim groups S2 (64.22%) and S3 (59.61%) together as 'around 65-70%', but S3's median is 5-10pp below the claimed range and essentially the same as S4's value. S5 at 52.89% is also below the claimed 'around 55-60%'. The data and code are sound, but the paper's stated ranges overstate the expert-only medians (especially S3) and do not accurately describe the computed cross-model distributions.
